name: Final Project for the Creative Core Pathway
author: Yrisel
description:
My final project for the Creative Core Pathway.

It was quite a long 2 weeks (free time) journey for this project alone (aside from the whole pathway experience), learning lots of stuff, from skyboxes, water, underwater, props, animations, lighting and materials, object pooling, etc.

I enjoyed this learning experience a lot. I'm looking forward for my next challenges.

Notes: I was running out of time to deliver this final project. Sadly, there were things that I didn't managed to add to the project. But there are a lot of others that did managed to get into the final release like:

- Dynamic skyboxes
- Time of day
- Lights turn on and off depending on the time
- Dolphins spawn at random (pre-determined) locations. Yes, there are dolphins roaming in the water :D
- Sounds! Waves, footsteps and background noise.
- Water, underwater effects, waterfalls!
- UI

And more!

I hope you enjoy this project as much as I do, and did developing it.
